verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Runloop MCP server documented on the AI-tools page (runloop-probe-4), and that page is described as adding Runloop API context to LLMs (runloop-docs-36). The pack gives no detail on its tools, transport, auth, or agent setup. The MCP Hub feature (giving agents access to third-party MCP tool servers) is an adjacent proxy capability, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented tool coverage of the MCP server, setup/connection instructions for agent clients, auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
